recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No current core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-38183 because the original R5 source application happened and later current-build refactoring moved the trial-use operation out of core rather than leaving stale Patient wording.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive issue for the Patient page. It asked to update Merging records to point readers to the new Patient $merge operation, move that section before Linking Patients, flag it as Trial Use for R5, and update the Duplicate Patient records subsection to reference $merge.
initial_application: Git commit 904fb177db applied the disposition to source/patient/patient-notes.xml by moving Merging records before Linking Patients, adding a Trial Use badge, linking to patient-operation-merge.html, and replacing the old 'This specification does not specify merge functionality' text. Merge commit 0a2bb94a31 integrated that application.
additional_context: PA minutes recorded the FHIR-38183 Persuasive 3-0-0 vote and the intent to notify FMG because normative Patient content was being updated. FMG minutes on 2022-11-16 said the Patient merge content would have to be published in R5 as Trial Use. Later commit 90c3b9ffc4 removed the local Patient-page Trial Use badge with a note that the operation itself still needed removal, and b487fdda4b removed Patient-merge from the core operations list while changing Patient narrative links to the Administrative Incubator $merge page. That linked page currently shows Standards status Trial-use.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/patient/patient-notes.xml keeps Merging records before Linking Patients, references the external $merge page in both relevant paragraphs, and no longer contains the obsolete no-merge-functionality text. The absent local Trial Use badge is explained by the later move of the operation out of core.
